svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/145.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" version="29.6.1" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="9clxD8v9IREv9yV3Pmlu"> <mxGraphModel dx="1243" dy="616" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="0" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml
title TEMP? transaction

caption Host (uartctl.py) ↔ Gateway (STM32 + nRF24) ↔ Remote (STM32 + nRF24)

skinparam shadowing false
skinparam ArrowColor #444444
skinparam ArrowThickness 1.2

skinparam activity {
 BorderColor #444444
 FontColor #222222
 BackgroundColor #f8f8f8
}

|Host|
start
:Open serial port;
:UART TX \"TEMP?\n\";

:Wait for 1 line (host timeout);


|Gateway|
:UART RX until '\n';
if (line == \"TEMP?\") then (yes)
else (no)
 :UART TX \"ERR\n\";
 |Host|
 :Read \"ERR\";
 :Host reports bad response;
 stop
endif

|Gateway|
:Prepare RF req \"GTMP\";
:nrf_enter_tx_clean();
:nrf_write_payload32();
:CE pulse;

' ---- TX wait (<=100 ms) ----
:tx_done = 0;
:tx_maxrt = 0;

while (elapsed < 100 ms? and tx_done == 0 and tx_maxrt == 0) is (yes)
 :st = STATUS;
 if (TX_DS?) then (yes)
 :clear IRQs;\nread OBSERVE_TX;
 :tx_done = 1;
 else (no)
 if (MAX_RT?) then (yes)
 :clear IRQs;\nread OBSERVE_TX;
 :flush TX;\nenter RX clean;
 :tx_maxrt = 1;
 endif
 endif
endwhile

|Gateway|
if (tx_maxrt == 1) then (MAX_RT)
 :UART TX \"TEMP FAIL rc=-1 ...\n\";
 |Host|
 :Read line \"TEMP FAIL ...\";
 :Host prints/returns error;
 stop
endif

|Gateway|
if (tx_done == 0) then (TXWAIT)
 :clear IRQs;\nflush TX;\nenter RX clean;
 :UART TX \"TEMP FAIL rc=-3 ...\n\";
 |Host|
 :Read line \"TEMP FAIL ...\";
 :Host prints/returns error;
 stop
endif

' ---- RX wait (<=200 ms) ----
|Gateway|
:nrf_enter_rx_clean();
:got_tmp = 0;

fork
 ' Branch 1: Gateway waits
 |Gateway|
 while (elapsed < 200 ms? and got_tmp == 0) is (yes)
 while (nrf_rx_available? and got_tmp == 0) is (yes)
 :read_payload32();
 :clear IRQs;
 if (hdr == \"TMP!\") then (yes)
 :got_tmp = 1;
 else (no)
 :drain unexpected payload;
 endif
 endwhile
 endwhile

fork again
 ' Branch 2: Remote processes request and replies
 |Remote|
 :Remote already in RX mode, polling each loop;
 while (nrf_rx_available?) is (yes)
 :read_payload32();
 :clear IRQs;
 if (hdr == \"GTMP\") then (yes)
 :Compose \"TMP!\" reply;
 :nrf_send_reply32(...);
 else (other)
 :Ignore / other command;
 endif
 endwhile
end fork

|Gateway|
if (got_tmp == 0) then (RX timeout)
 :read RPD;
 :UART TX \"TEMP FAIL rc=-2 ...\n\";
 |Host|
 :Read line \"TEMP FAIL ...\";
 :Host prints/returns error;
 stop
endif

|Gateway|
:Unpack TMP! fields;
:UART TX \"TEMP ADC0=.. ADC1=.. T0=.. T1=.. age=.. flags=..\n\";


|Host|
:Read response line;
if (line starts with \"TEMP \") then (yes)
 :parse_temp_line();
 if (parse OK?) then (yes)
 if (--json?) then (yes)
 :emit JSON;
 else (no)
 :print human output;
 endif
 else (no)
 :Host parse error;
 endif
else (no)
 :Host bad response;
endif
stop
